House Info & Instructions

Door Code: 0179  
WiFi: 762 Ivey  
Password: Dragon85!

Security & Doors
• There are cameras at the front door, pool door, and garage door. Just a heads up 😊  
• Please make sure all doors stay locked at night and anytime you leave the house.  
• I’ll make a quick video showing how to use the door locks and keypad system.

Temperature / AC
• The thermostat is in the hallway. Feel free to adjust it to whatever temperature is comfortable for you.  
• Fair warning: we usually keep the house pretty cold because we all run hot 😂  
• I’ll make a quick video showing how to use the thermostat.

Pets

Cats
• The cats’ food, water, and litter box are in the bathroom near the garage.  
• Their water may need to be refreshed midway through the week.  
• Their food bowl should stay full, although Duke tends to overeat sometimes.  
• Extra cat food is in the mud room in the right-hand closet closest to the door.

IMPORTANT:
• Both cats are strictly indoor cats and should NEVER leave the house.  
• Duke especially likes to sneak outside into the pool area, so always shut the pool door immediately behind you.  
• If he gets out, it becomes a nightmare trying to get him back inside 😅

About the cats:
• Duchess is very shy and usually hangs out in my closet or the storage room. She mainly comes out for treats and gentle pets. She’s super sweet.  
• Duke is the self-appointed king of the house and can be a little bit of a jerk sometimes 😂 He’s very social and will probably sleep at the foot of your bed.

Dog
• The dog’s food and water are in the laundry room.  
• His water system works like a water cooler jug. Just keep an eye on it and refill it if needed using the bottom nozzle.  
• Dog food is in the large container next to the washer. If it runs out, you can refill his automatic feeder.

Bathroom / Outside Rules:
• He goes outside into the pool area and uses the mulch area for the bathroom.  
• DO NOT let him near the garden area.  
• Never take him outside the gate without a leash because he is absolutely a runner.

Walks
• You are welcome to walk him if you’d like, but you definitely don’t have to.  
• If you do, please use both the harness and leash. The harness is marked with an “L” for left.  
• He gets hot and tired quickly, so just a short neighborhood walk is plenty.

Sleeping
• He’ll probably sleep either in our bedroom, Donivan’s room, or on the couch.  
• He is not allowed on beds except Donivan’s bed.  
• The couch battle has already been lost, so he owns that now 😂

Treats
• I’ll leave treats out for everyone.  
• The pets can each have treats once a day whenever you want to give them one.  
• They’ll definitely let you know when it’s treat time by staring at the pantry and acting dramatic.

Kitchen / Food
• Please help yourself to anything in the pantry or fridge, including drinks.

Appliances
• Dishwasher pods are underneath the sink.  
• I’ll make a quick video showing how the dishwasher works.  
• The oven is pretty self-explanatory.

Garden & Plants
Outdoor Garden:
• If it isn’t raining, the garden needs to be watered.  
• The hose is already set up by the vegetable garden.  
• The valve/nozzle to turn it on is near the pool toy bin beside the pool door.  
• The switches are a little weird, so I’ll make a quick video showing how to turn everything on properly.

Vegetables by the Kitchen Window:
• The vegetables under the kitchen windowsill also need watering if it’s dry outside.  
• There’s a bucket you can fill using the garden hose and carry over to them.  
• Don’t overwater them, but every other day is probably good if there’s no rain.

Indoor Plants:
• There are two houseplants in the living room that need water once during the week.  
• The orchids near the window each need 3 ice cubes placed near their roots once during the week.

Trash & Mail
• Trash day is Monday night. If you could take the trash cans to the curb Monday evening, that would be amazing.  
• We don’t get much mail, but if you happen to notice the mailbox filling up, feel free to bring it inside.

Pool Guys
• The pool guys come on Thursday and will enter through the back gate, so don’t be alarmed if you hear them outside.

TVs
• The living room TV has basically every streaming service and channel imaginable.  
• The bedroom TV has Netflix, Amazon, and I think HBO Max.

Emergency / Contact Info

Sharron Hotchkiss  
661-964-8116

John Hotchkiss  
(615) 393-9812

Skip Armistead (neighbor with the garden)  
931-378-0824

Lea Mascarenhas (landlord)  
616-309-3942

• Lea lives across the street, although they’ll also be out of town.  
• If there is any type of house emergency, please contact both her and me.

Videos I’ll Make For You
1. How to use the front door keypad & locks  
2. How to adjust the thermostat/AC  
3. How to use the dishwasher  
4. How to turn on the garden hose/water system  
5. Quick walkthrough of pet food/water locations  
6. Pool area + gate rules for the dog/cats  
:::

Rewrite this to make it more cohesive and flow better for my house sitter to follow and then at the bottom list what videos I'm going to make in order to help him make sense of some of the complicated stuff. : Door code # 0179
WiFi: 762 Ivey  PW: Dragon85!

There is a camera on each door: front door, pool door and garage door. Just FYI 😜 but please lock all the doors at night or when you leave. I'll make a video of how to use the door code/lock. 

AC unit is in the hall way, feel free to put that To whatever temperature you want. I'll make a video of how to set that. We run hot so house is usually cold 🤣

The cats food/water/liter box is in the bathroom near the garage. The water might need to be replaced halfway through the week. And the food bowl should remain full, but sometimes Duke is a pig. So the cat food is in the mud room in the right hand closet nearest the door. 

The dog food is in the laundry room along with his water. Just keep an eye on the water and make sure it is full. It's like a water cooler replacement. It just spins out and you can fill it on the bottom nozzle. The dog food is next to the washer and it big container. If it runs out you can put it in his auto feeder. 

The dog is let out into the pool area and goes to the bathroom the mulch. He is never to be out near the garden or let out outside of that gate without being on a leash. He's a runner. 

The cat is also a runner and likes to go out into the pool area and is not allowed to leave the house ever. Don't let him tell you otherwise. Both cats stay inside 24/7. So make sure to keep the doors closed at all times. Especially the pool door behind you or the cat will get out and you will have a nightmare trying to get him back into the house. 

I will leave treats out for both animals and they can get them once a day if you would like to give them a some. The time does not matter but they will tell you when they want one by going over to the pantry and begging. 

Eat whatever you want in the pantry/fridge. Drink whatever you want in the pantry. 

The dishwasher soap pods are underneath the sink and I will make a video on how to use the dishwasher. The oven is self-explanatory. 

The garden needs to be watered if it's not raining. There is a hose that is already out by my vegetables. And the nozzle to turn it on is on the other side of the pool toy bin right next to the pool door. I will create a video to show you how to turn that on because there are some switches that are kind of weird. There are also some vegetables underneath the windowsill next to the kitchen that need to be watered if it's not raining, and there is a bucket that can be filled by the hose in the garden and brought to water those. Don't over water but maybe every other day. If it's not raining make sure they don't get too hot. 

Trash day is Monday night. If you could make sure to take the trash to the curb on Monday night that would be super helpful thank you. 

I don't get a lot of mail but every once in awhile it starts to fill up with junk. If you think about it, you can bring it in. 

The pool guys come on Thursday so don't be alarmed when they come in through the back gate. 

You can walk the dog if you'd like but you don't have to. If you do you have to use the harness (there is an L for left on harness) and the leash. He is not a very long walker. He gets hot pretty fast and he is out of shape so I wouldn't go more than around the neighborhood if you take him. 

The dog will most likely sleep in our bedroom or in Donivan's bed or on the couch at night. Just depends on if you like the door shut and if you do you can bring the dog in with you. He can't be on any beds (other than D's) but he has claimed the couch and we can't stop him at this point. 

Duchess likes to hang out in my closet or in the storage room and only comes out for treats and bathroom pets. She is super sweet but very shy. 

Duke is a dick sometimes. He is the alpha of the house and can be a bully at times. He will definitely be sleeping with you in your bed at the feet. He is very friendly in the morning and both cats use cat door at night. 

The TV remotes are pretty easy to use. The living room TV has basically every channel and streaming device known to man. The bedroom one is Netflix, Amazon and maybe HBO Max. I'm not sure. 

There are two house plants inside the house in the living room that need to be watered once a week. 

Also, my orchids near the window need three ice cubes near their roots per orchid once a week.
